title: Tied Together Under a Laser Grid — Part 5

series.summary: Rentarou and Karane crawl tied back-to-back beneath a web of security lasers, and halfway through Karane breaks down sobbing before her tsundere fire snaps her back.

segments.voiceover_text: The next hallway is a trap — a web of glowing red security lasers from floor to ceiling. The only way through: Rentarou and Karane, tied back-to-back, sliding beneath the beams. Karane is mortified by the plan. She volunteers anyway.

Inch by inch they crawl, Karane riding his back, laser beams kissing their hair. Halfway through, Karane breaks — sobbing for the friend waiting above them. Then she explodes at her own tears, furious at herself for doubting. That fire is exactly why they will make it. Now all that stands between them and Hakari is one last door.
